data: NVIDIA's operating income grew about **1,828%** between fiscal 2023 and fiscal 2025. In fiscal 2023, which ended January 29, 2023, operating income was $4.224 billion. In fiscal 2025, which ended January 26, 2025, it was $81.453 billion. That is an increase of roughly $77.2 billion, or about 19.3 times the fiscal 2023 level. Most of the growth came from data center revenue tied to AI accelerators. Fiscal 2024 sat in between at $32.972 billion. These figures come from NVIDIA's reported GAAP results as I recall them, not from a filing I checked here.
